你认为我应该打电话给他吗？
例句：For some reason, I keep thinking it’s Friday today.
不知为什么，我总觉得今天是周五。
例句：The recession lasted longer than anyone thought it would.
谁也没有想到这次经济萧条会持续这么久。
例句：Am I right in thinking that you have a brother?
我想你是有个兄弟的，对吗？
例句：I can’t help thinking that he’s made a mistake.
我总觉得他弄错了。
例句：Do you honestly think I would do something so stupid?
你真认为我会做这么愚蠢的事吗？
例句：We must start thinking in terms of reducing costs.
我们必须开始考虑降低成本了。

receive
音标：英 /rɪ'siːv/  美 /rɪ'siv/
v.  收到， 得到
例句：All the children will receive a small gift.
每个孩子都会收到一份小礼物。
例句：Lee received 324 votes (= 324 people voted for him ) .
李得到324票。

thirst
音标：英 /θɜːst/  美 /θɝst/
n.  渴， 口渴
短语：thirst for — v. 渴望；热望
短语：thirst for knowledge — 渴望求知，求知欲
短语：have a thirst — [口语]想喝杯酒
短语：die of thirst — 口渴死
短语：thirst for revenge — 渴望复仇
短语：thirst after — 非常渴望
例句：Ice water is the only thing that really quenches my thirst (= gets rid of it ) .
只有冰水才能让我真正解渴。
例句：We had worked up a thirst (= done something that made us thirsty ) ，and so we decided to stop for a beer.
我们干得口渴了，因此决定停下来喝杯啤酒。
例句：Maggie woke up with a raging thirst (= an extremely strong thirst ) .
玛吉醒来时感到口干舌燥。

participate
音标：英 /pɑː'tɪsɪpeɪt/  美 /pɑr'tɪsə'pet/
vi.  参加， 参与
短语：participate in — 参加；分享
短语：participate in social activities — 参与社会活动
例句：Some members refused to participate.
有些会员拒绝参加。
